# Pack: consulting

Consulting and advisory services, version 0.1.0, extends [base](pack-base.md).

Consulting-sector pack: service categories, unit templates, provider types, realization and staffing concepts, review rules for outcome-based fees, and engagement templates for role-based time and materials, capped time and materials, phased fixed fees, hours-drawdown retainers, and fixed fees with a success component.

Evidence classes: A_DIRECT (directly documented), B_CORROBORATED, C_INFERENCE, D_PROPOSED. C and D are inference or proposal, not observed fact.

## Realization, staffing, and fee concepts for consulting

Scheme `consulting_concepts`.

<a id="cons-001"></a>

**CONS-001** Realization (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Billed or contractual value divided by the value of hours worked at standard rates. Below 1 means a write-down; above 1 means a write-up.

- Synonyms: realization rate
- Related: [FM-028](pack-base.md#fm-028) Realization, [CONS-002](#cons-002) Write-down, [CONS-005](#cons-005) Standard rate card
- Attributes: formula: contractual_fee / standard_value; computed_by: realization
- Caveat: Definitions vary by organization; record the convention used.

<a id="cons-002"></a>

**CONS-002** Write-down (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Standard value of hours worked minus the contractual fee for those hours.

- Related: [CONS-001](#cons-001) Realization
- Attributes: formula: standard_value - contractual_fee; computed_by: write_down

<a id="cons-003"></a>

**CONS-003** Effective billing rate (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Contractual fee divided by hours worked. For fixed fees it is retrospective.

- Related: [FM-023](pack-base.md#fm-023) Effective billing rate
- Attributes: formula: contractual_fee / worked_hours; computed_by: effective_billing_rate

<a id="cons-004"></a>

**CONS-004** Staffing leverage (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The ratio of junior to senior effort on an engagement. It is a major direct-cost lever; a mix that is too junior can damage quality.

- Synonyms: pyramid, seniority mix
- Related: [CL-D04](pack-base.md#cl-d04) Seniority and skill mix, [PM-002](pack-base.md#pm-002) Blended hourly rate, [PM-003](pack-base.md#pm-003) Role or seniority rate card

<a id="cons-005"></a>

**CONS-005** Standard rate card (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The rate per role used to value hours worked, independent of the contracted price.

- Related: [PM-003](pack-base.md#pm-003) Role or seniority rate card, [CONS-001](#cons-001) Realization
- Attributes: engine_field: delivery_plan.standard_rate_card

<a id="cons-006"></a>

**CONS-006** Phased fixed fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A fixed fee per phase, with each phase repriced or confirmed at its checkpoint.

- Related: [PM-017](pack-base.md#pm-017) Phase-based fee, [PM-006](pack-base.md#pm-006) Fixed-fee project

<a id="cons-007"></a>

**CONS-007** Hours-drawdown retainer (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A periodic fee that includes a number of hours, with overage above the allowance.

- Related: [CL-R04](pack-base.md#cl-r04) Retainer drawdown, [PM-008](pack-base.md#pm-008) Monthly or annual retainer, [CL-V01](pack-base.md#cl-v01) Included allowance, [CL-V02](pack-base.md#cl-v02) Overage

<a id="cons-008"></a>

**CONS-008** Success fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A fee contingent on a defined result. It needs a measurable metric, a baseline or target, an attribution method, a cap, and approval.

- Related: [PM-025](pack-base.md#pm-025) Performance incentive or bonus, [PM-026](pack-base.md#pm-026) Gain-share or verified savings, [PM-027](pack-base.md#pm-027) Success or contingent fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0006](pack-base.md#clm-b-0006), [CLM-B-0041](pack-base.md#clm-b-0041)
- Attributes: engine_method: OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT

<a id="scheme-provider-types"></a>

## Consulting provider types

Scheme `provider_types`.

<a id="large_advisory_firm"></a>

**LARGE_ADVISORY_FIRM** Large advisory firm (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A multi-practice firm delivering advisory, implementation, and managed services, sometimes alongside audit or assurance work.

- Attributes: commercial_implications: Where the firm also provides assurance to the client, independence rules may restrict contingent or outcome-based fees; review before proposing them.

<a id="boutique"></a>

**BOUTIQUE** Boutique (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A specialist firm focused on a sector, function, or method.

- Attributes: commercial_implications: Smaller teams make dedicated-resource pricing and capacity commitments a material utilization risk.

<a id="independent_practitioner"></a>

**INDEPENDENT_PRACTITIONER** Independent practitioner (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

An individual consultant or small partnership contracting directly.

- Attributes: commercial_implications: Retainers and capped time and materials limit exposure to concentration and idle time.

<a id="technology_integrator"></a>

**TECHNOLOGY_INTEGRATOR** Technology integrator (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A firm delivering system implementation and support, often with platform or license components.

- Attributes: commercial_implications: Implementation plus recurring support (PM-029) separates setup recovery from run economics.

<a id="scheme-service-categories"></a>

## Consulting service categories

Scheme `service_categories`.

<a id="strategy"></a>

**STRATEGY** Strategy (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Advisory work on direction, portfolio, market, or organizational choices, usually scoped by questions rather than volumes.

<a id="operations_improvement"></a>

**OPERATIONS_IMPROVEMENT** Operations improvement (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Diagnosis and redesign of processes, cost structures, or service levels, often with a measurable baseline.

<a id="transformation"></a>

**TRANSFORMATION** Transformation (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Multi-phase change programs combining design, implementation, and adoption, with scope that evolves between phases.

<a id="implementation"></a>

**IMPLEMENTATION** Implementation (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Delivery of a defined system, process, or operating model to an acceptance point.

<a id="advisory_retainer"></a>

**ADVISORY_RETAINER** Advisory retainer (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Ongoing access to advisers for a periodic fee, typically drawn down against included hours.

- Related: [PM-008](pack-base.md#pm-008) Monthly or annual retainer, [CL-R04](pack-base.md#cl-r04) Retainer drawdown

<a id="interim_management"></a>

**INTERIM_MANAGEMENT** Interim management (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Placement of an executive or specialist into a client role for a period, priced by time or by resource.

- Related: [PM-004](pack-base.md#pm-004) Dedicated FTE or resource unit, [PM-005](pack-base.md#pm-005) Staff augmentation or secondment

<a id="scheme-unit-templates"></a>

## Consulting unit templates

Scheme `unit_templates`.

<a id="consultant_day"></a>

**consultant_day** Consultant day (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One day of consultant effort.

- Attributes: kind: HOURS; counting_rule_prompt: How many hours make a billable day, and are partial days rounded?; acceptance_rule_prompt: Who approves timesheets, and within what period?; complexity_note: Day rates often differ by seniority; record a rate per role.

<a id="accepted_deliverable"></a>

**accepted_deliverable** Accepted deliverable (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One deliverable accepted by the client against defined acceptance criteria.

- Attributes: kind: COUNT; counting_rule_prompt: Which deliverables are in scope, and what makes each one distinct?; acceptance_rule_prompt: What are the acceptance criteria, who signs off, and what happens on silence?; complexity_note: Acceptance ambiguity is a common source of disputes on deliverable-based fees.

<a id="workstream_month"></a>

**workstream_month** Workstream month (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One month of an agreed workstream with a defined team and objective.

- Attributes: kind: COUNT; counting_rule_prompt: What team and scope define one workstream?; acceptance_rule_prompt: What evidence closes out a workstream month?; complexity_note: Equivalent to a capacity reservation if the team is held for the client.

## Rules

<a id="cons-r-001"></a>

**CONS-R-001** `CONSULTING_OUTCOME_FEE_REVIEW` (constraint, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, evaluated)

Outcome-based consideration needs review; independence and professional rules may restrict contingent fees for some advisory work, for example where the provider also gives assurance to the client.

- Why: Outcome fees need a baseline, attribution, cap, and approval, and some advisory relationships restrict contingent compensation.
- Evidence: `C_INFERENCE`
- Claims: [CLM-B-0041](pack-base.md#clm-b-0041)

<details><summary>Condition</summary>

```json
{
 "path": "arrangement_versions[*].components[*].billing_basis",
 "equals": "OUTCOME"
}
```

</details>

<a id="cons-r-002"></a>

**CONS-R-002** `CONSULTING_UNCAPPED_TIME_ON_UNCERTAIN_SCOPE` (reasoning, INFO, evaluated)

Uncapped time and materials on strategy or transformation scope leaves the client with duration risk; consider a cap or a phased fixed fee.

- Why: Selection heuristic for highly uncertain scope; an inference, not a rule.
- Evidence: `C_INFERENCE`

<details><summary>Condition</summary>

```json
{
 "all": [
  {
   "path": "arrangement_versions[*].components[*].calculation_method",
   "equals": "TIME"
  },
  {
   "path": "services[*].service_category",
   "in": [
    "STRATEGY",
    "TRANSFORMATION"
   ]
  },
  {
   "not": {
    "path": "arrangement_versions[*].adjustments[*].type",
    "equals": "CAP"
   }
  }
 ]
}
```

</details>

<a id="cons-r-003"></a>

**CONS-R-003** `CONSULTING_FIXED_FEE_SCOPE_CONTROL` (reasoning, INFO, evaluated)

A fixed project fee needs scope assumptions, exclusions, and change-order triggers to bound the provider's effort risk.

- Why: Fixed project fees transfer execution and overrun risk to the provider.
- Evidence: `C_INFERENCE`
- Claims: [CLM-B-0049](pack-base.md#clm-b-0049)

<details><summary>Condition</summary>

```json
{
 "path": "arrangement_versions[*].components[*].calculation_method",
 "equals": "FIXED_PROJECT"
}
```

</details>
